purpose: Convert the SEIS developer role roadmap into a 90-day milestone matrix with project outputs and validation gates.

cadence.week_9_to_12: Enterprise readiness, validation, and PR polish

milestones.title: Repository foundation and review habits
outputs: Read README and architecture entry points
Identify local, mock, planned, disabled, and live state labels
Run the developer role roadmap validation script
Create one small scoped issue from the roadmap
validation: Manual review of issue scope and rollback note

milestones.title: Product surface literacy
outputs: Map one product surface to state labels
Write accessibility and responsive review notes

milestones.title: Contracts and data safety
outputs: Draft one API or data contract
Add one schema or data quality checklist
Document backup, restore, privacy, and migration assumptions
validation: Contract has inputs, outputs, failure states, and rollback notes
Private data is excluded from public examples

milestones.title: Automation and DevOps readiness
outputs: Document CI or local validation expectations
Describe cloud, SSH, and deployment approval gates
validation: Dry-run and live actions are separated

milestones.title: Full-stack vertical slice
outputs: One thin SEIS feature slice is planned end-to-end
UI, API, data, AI, validation, and rollback notes are linked
PR summary explains what is real, planned, mocked, or disabled

milestones.title: Enterprise readiness review
outputs: Map the role roadmap to enterprise readiness gates
Identify missing evidence for strong claims
